newsitem.title: UK: Sterling falls after UK purchasing managers data.
newsitem.headline: Sterling falls after UK purchasing managers data.

text.p: 0840 GMT - Stg slips after UK purchasing managers' data, down a pfennig from five-year high of 2.91 marks set overnight.

* UK June purchasing managers' index at 53.4 vs 54.4 in May, output index down at 55.0, lowest rate so far this year, vs 57.4 in May. Survey shows stg strengh dampened foreign demand, though offset by growth overseas. Consumer demand remains buoyant.
* Stg/mark at 2.9000/10 vs 2.9068 before data and 2.9026/36 late Monday in Europe. Cable at $1.6648/58 vs $1.6655 before release and $1.6640/45 late yesterday.
* CBI's Turner, BoE's George to speak on EMU later today.
